description: This file contains unit tests for helper functions that process WhatsApp message data, extracting text, contact info, location data, and handling media placeholders.

methods.name: extractText
methods.description: Extracts main text content from various types of WhatsApp message objects, handling contact cards, captions, and message types.

methods.name: extractLocationData
methods.description: Extracts location information such as latitude, longitude, caption, and source from WhatsApp location and live location messages.

methods.name: extractMediaPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns a placeholder string for media messages when actual media content is not required or available.
